_**We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data & AI Architecture, based in Copenhagen or London, to lead our team of four Data, AI and Solution Architects and serve as the design authority for Pandora’s Data & AI platform. This is a genuine dual role. You’ll set the architectural direction and standards, while remaining close enough to the technology to challenge, review and approve the designs that matter.

_**Our target architecture is Databricks, including Delta Lake, medallion patterns and Unity Catalog, while Azure Synapse and its conformed enterprise models continue to power a significant part of the estate across supply chain, commerce, manufacturing, corporate technology and omni-channel.

A critical part of the role is leading the transition to Databricks: shaping the target architecture, determining where ownership sits as the platform evolves, and ensuring existing solutions remain coherent and supported throughout the journey.

The role is approximately 60% architecture and 40% people leadership. You’ll lead and develop four architects, but this is not a role where technical accountability is delegated to the team. Both sides of the role are real, and you’ll be expected to lead both.

**Scope and authority

**

• Design authority for Data & Analytics: approves data and AI solution designs, and can require rework, attach conditions to an approval, or withhold approval.

• Chairs the architecture review forum, setting its standards, cadence and quality gates, and deciding what requires review against what is already covered by an approved pattern.

• Resolves conflicting design positions across architects, lead engineers and delivery teams.

• Owns reference architectures, solution patterns, data contracts and architecture decision records — accountable for their adoption, not just their publication.

• Owns the team's roadmap, capacity allocation across workstreams, and budget, including engagement of external consulting resources.

• Translates and enforces the Data & AI architecture strategy set by the Global Director, and informs how it evolves.

**Job Responsibilities

****Architecture

**

• Set and enforce the standards for what is built on Databricks as the target architecture, what remains on Synapse for now, and what is retired — and on what evidence.

• Decide how data products are aligned: source-aligned versus domain-aligned versus consumer-aligned, where ownership and stewardship sit, and where a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) serves better than distributed ownership.

• Review technical designs from solution architects and lead engineers against platform standards; give feedback that changes the design, not just documents it.

• Define and evolve reference architectures, solution patterns and data contracts so that quality is built in rather than inspected in.

• Lead design sessions with architects, engineering and business stakeholders on complex or contested problems.

• Oversee transitional architectures through to legacy decommission, maintaining business continuity and closing the parallel run.

**AI architecture

**

• Set and enforce architecture standards for agentic systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation, guardrails and observability.

• Set and enforce architecture standards for ML systems: feature reuse, training and serving topology, model lifecycle, and monitoring for drift.

• Approve AI solution designs with enough depth to arbitrate them on the technical merits, and in line with AI policy and applicable regulation.

**Governance and regulation

**

• Embed privacy-by-design and personal data handling requirements into platform patterns, particularly across commerce and omni-channel.

• Maintain computational governance: data quality frameworks, contracts and lineage as platform capability rather than project effort.

**Team leadership

**

• Line management for four architects: coaching, performance, career development, hiring.

• Establish ways of working — review process, documentation standards, quality gates — and hold the team to them.

• Represent architecture in leadership forums, steering committees and cross-functional planning.

• Keep architects hands-on and embedded with engineering teams; architecture produced at a distance from delivery does not land.

**What You Will Have Done By Month 12

**

• A published and adopted standard for what is built on Databricks, with evidence of designs changed by it.

• A clear model for data product alignment and ownership, applied on live work rather than documented in isolation.

• An architecture review forum running to a predictable cadence, with a visible ADR record and a known path for challenging a decision.

• Approved agentic and ML reference patterns in use.

• At least one legacy component fully decommissioned, not just superseded.

• A development plan in place for each of the four architects, and any open roles filled.

**Essential Experience

**

• 5+ years designing and delivering production data platform solutions at enterprise scale, hands-on.

• At least 2 years line-managing technical specialists, including performance management, career development and hiring.

• Has held a design approval or architecture governance mandate, including declining designs and making that decision hold.

• Has led a platform migration or a parallel-run estate through to legacy decommission.

• Deep working knowledge of Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion, Unity Catalog) as a target architecture, plus enough Azure Synapse (star schemas, conformed models, dedicated pools) to govern what remains there, and pipeline orchestration with ADF or Databricks Workflows.

• Has designed source-aligned, domain-aligned and consumer-aligned data products, with a clear view of where distributed domain ownership beats a conformed enterprise model (CDM/RDM) and where it does not.

• Has implemented or governed a domain ownership model — data mesh or similar — including the federated governance and stewardship that makes it work.

• Has architected agentic and ML systems: orchestration, tool and data access boundaries, evaluation and guardrails; feature and model lifecycle, serving, and monitoring for drift.

• Has set architecture standards that others adopted — solution patterns, reference architectures and architecture decision records.

• Has implemented data quality frameworks, data contracts or computational governance in production.

• Holds an architectural position under delivery pressure, and judges well when to concede.

• Communicates architecture clearly to technical and business audiences, including solution designs, ADRs and data flow diagrams.

• Understanding of retail, manufacturing, finance or supply chain business processes and how data flows through a business.

**Desirable

**

• Familiarity with EU AI Act obligations and enterprise AI governance.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

****Lead Software Engineer – Payments

**Remote - **_Must be Copenhagen based

_**

**About The Role

**At OrderYOYO, payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Payments to help us build a more resilient, scalable, and compliant payments operating model — across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — across a rapidly growing, international restaurant platform.

****Role Mission

****Own and evolve OrderYOYO's payments capabilities — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

****Core Responsibilities

• Design, build, and operate payment-domain services, including gateway integrations and payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.

• Implement marketplace capabilities where relevant: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.

• Build robust “flow-of-funds” primitives — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails — that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.

• Integrate with PSP and partner tooling, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.

• Implement dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and collaborate with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.

• Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.

• Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain through automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements — and mentor engineers, lead design reviews, and contribute to shared standards and documentation. Payments is too critical to be tribal knowledge.

**Must-Have Requirements

**

• Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.

• Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.

• A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.

• Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.

• Clear, confident communication with non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.

**Strong-to-Have Experience

**

• Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).

• Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of DKK66,000/ month

• A role based in Copenhagen.

• High ownership and autonomy over the services you build.

• The opportunity to work on revenue-critical production systems.

• A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

• Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and personal development.

Picture your typical week: on Monday you’re on-site at a pharmaceutical client, leading a cross-functional team through a critical MES go-live. By Wednesday you’re working with the IT leadership to turn your delivery results into a business case for the next phase. Friday, you’re back at Emendo’s Nordhavn office sharing what you learned and sharpening the methods your colleagues will use on their projects. If that sounds like work you’d love, keep reading.

Why We’re Hiring Now

We paused hiring over the past year to be deliberate about the team we build next. The consulting market in Denmark has tightened, and our clients have changed how they buy: they want fewer consultants with more experience, people who can walk into a complex situation and show measurable progress within weeks, not months. We are now making a small number of senior hires — each one matters, and we are taking the time to find the right people.

About Emendo

Emendo is a 200-person consultancy built by people who used to sit on the client side — running transformation programmes inside pharma before deciding to do it for a living. We understand the pressure a site director feels before a go-live, we know what an inspector looks for, and we speak the language of the people who operate the systems we implement. We work across the full pharmaceutical value chain from R&D through shipping, with offices in Copenhagen, Kalundborg, Odense, Silkeborg, Munich, and Raleigh (USA). Our strategy is simple: deliver faster, prove value in hard numbers, and use our methods and AI tools to do what we do well — only quicker.

We are a methods-driven firm rooted in operational excellence and Lean. Our motto, Observe, Think, Improve, is itself a method: go to the floor, understand what is actually happening, analyse it rigorously, then design and implement a concrete improvement. That simplicity is what makes it reliable when the project gets complicated and the usual playbooks stop working.

The Role

You will lead IT/OT transformation engagements for clients in pharma and regulated industries — operating at the intersection of technology, business process, and organisational change. You are expected to create measurable impact from the outset, build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Emendo’s footprint within your accounts. At Emendo, seniority means more than years served: it means sound judgement in ambiguity, credibility with demanding stakeholders, and the willingness to raise the standard of the whole team.

What You Will Do

• Lead client engagements on-site, owning delivery of IT/OT implementations across enterprise, operations management, process control, and process equipment layers

• Drive measurable progress in short cycles — the kind your client’s leadership can point to in a steering committee: cost reduced, lead time shortened, risk closed out

• Manage project governance, solution architecture alignment, and validation concepts within complex, multi-stakeholder environments

• Shape how Emendo works — contribute to our methods, package what you learn into repeatable offerings and case studies, and use AI tools to deliver faster without cutting corners

• Build lasting client relationships — become a trusted partner to your stakeholders, spot opportunities for follow-on work, and contribute to Emendo’s business development by turning strong delivery into new engagements

• Apply Observe, Think, Improve as your foundation — and mentor junior colleagues to do the same

What It Takes

Must-Have Qualifications

• Master’s degree in engineering, IT, or a related discipline

• 6–10+ years of hands-on delivery experience in IT/OT project management, product ownership, or solution implementation — ideally within pharma or other regulated industries, though strong candidates from adjacent sectors are welcome

• Track record of delivering quantifiable business outcomes (cost reduction, lead-time improvement, risk mitigation) — not just on-time/on-budget projects

• Strong command of project governance, stakeholder management, and the ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior client leadership

• Deep understanding of at least one area: enterprise systems (ERP/MES), process control, IT–OT convergence, or value chain technology

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; Danish skills are strongly preferred, or a commitment to learn

• Willingness to work on-site at client locations in Denmark and occasionally internationally

Nice to have — but not required

None of the following are dealbreakers. If you tick even one or two, it tells us you will ramp up faster — but we have seen great consultants arrive without any of them and build the expertise here.

• Experience with GxP compliance, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), or regulatory frameworks in life sciences

• Familiarity with AI/automation tools applied to enterprise transformation or operational settings

• Background in operational excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies

• Experience working across multiple sites or geographies in global transformation programmes

• Comfort with outcome-based or fixed-price engagement models

What Makes Emendo Different

• Measured on outcomes, not utilisation — you work directly with industry leaders on engagements that matter

• One integrated firm with deep methods: cross-unit collaboration across Implementation, Engineering, Digital, and R&D, backed by a Lean toolbox and AI accelerators

• Freedom under responsibility — challenging projects with room to shape the solution and your own career

• A flat culture where your input matters and your wins are celebrated

• Competitive compensation reflecting the seniority and impact expected in this role

This role is probably not for you if:

• You prefer purely advisory work with limited implementation responsibility.

• You work best with narrow ownership and very clear boundaries.

• You have strong technical exposure but limited experience leading cross-functional change.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We are hiring two to three Senior Consultants this year. Each one joins a team that has led some of the largest IT/OT programmes in US and European pharma — people who chose Emendo because they wanted senior-level impact in a firm that still feels personal. If that resonates, we’d like to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We will be in touch promptly.
